newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen mixed in moderate trading.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen mixed in moderate trading.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are expected to be mixed in moderate trading on Thursday, with sentiment likely to remain firm on the cigarette and cement sectors, brokers said.
"Sentiment on these sectors are likely to remain firm as earlier worries of slow growth in these sectors were overdone," one broker said.
"Some speculative elements are also likely to further boost sentiment in these sectors," the broker said.
Brokers said market talk of a possible restructuring in Indocement and price increases in Sampoerna's cigarettes were likely to keep sentiment firm on both firms.
The broker said players were likely to continue taking profit in banking stocks due to worries of a possible spill-over of the turmoil in the Thai baht.
Another broker, however, said banking stocks were likely to continue under pressure but it was mostly due to profit-taking after the sector's recent strong gains.
On Wednesday, the Jakarta Composite Index eased 1.46 points, or 0.20 percent, to 730.16 points.
Second-liners Eterindo, Surya Semesta and Anwar Sierad were among the most active due to market talk of possible private placements, brokers said.
Brokers said the market was likely to remain slow the rest of the day, with second-liners likely to continue dominating the market due to a lack of fresh strong factors.
